title: Already Aboard
description: There's no reason to show a logged-in passenger the boarding gate again. Confirm PublicOnlyRoute actually redirects a signed-in user away from /login and /register instead of re-rendering the forms.
successCondition: While logged in, navigating directly to /login and separately to /register both redirect (client-side, via Navigate) to / (the dashboard) rather than rendering the login/register form — verified by checking the resulting URL and that dashboard content, not a form, is what's on screen after navigation settles.
hints: A direct browser navigation (not just clicking an in-app link) is the more faithful test, since it exercises the route guard fresh.
There's a brief "Loading…" state while auth resolves on mount — wait for it to clear before asserting on the final URL.
